requiredChecks: Parent fd[0] read CLOSED and fd[1] write OPEN; child fd[0] read OPEN and fd[1] write CLOSED.
Exactly two data arrowheads show parent OPEN fd[1] → Kernel buffer → child OPEN fd[0]; no arrow touches CLOSED cards or follows child border.
Both descriptors inherited after fork; unused ends closed; one-way parent-write child-read caption preserved.
prompt: Edit ordinary pipe after fork: preserve descriptor states and captions. Parent open fd[1] → kernel buffer → child open fd[0]. Route output upward in empty gap and right with one arrowhead on child fd[0]; no arrowhead at closed fd[1] row or container border.
sourceClarification: 원본의 양쪽 fd 화살표는 fork 뒤 디스크립터 상속과 혼동될 수 있다. 본문 코드의 부모 쓰기/자식 읽기, 불필요한 끝 close를 정확히 표현한다.
